verdict: Paid campaigns are dark; overdue deliverables are blocking the renewal decision.
narrative: No spend ran on Meta or Google Ads across the full 28-day window, so no paid leads or appointments were generated this period. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile activity dropped to zero in the most recent 7 days after averaging roughly 58 actions the week prior, and search clicks fell 19% week-over-week — your organic presence is softening with no paid activity underneath it. Three overdue deliverables — phone-match attribution, contact cleanup, and the reporting dashboard — are now past their due dates, which means the scoreboard needed to make a confident renewal decision is not yet in place; completing those is the immediate priority. Once attribution and the dashboard are live, spend performance can be measured accurately and the stay-or-walk decision can move forward on solid ground.

highlights.phrase: paid ad spend across all 28 days — no paid leads were generated this period
Google Business Profile actions recorded across the 28-day window (calls, directions, and site clicks)
pipeline opportunities opened in your CRM this period, with zero converted or appointed

watch_item.issue: Three setup milestones — phone-match attribution, contact cleanup, and the live dashboard — are overdue, leaving the renewal decision without a trusted scoreboard.
watch_item.fix: All three are being resolved now so that accurate reporting is in place before the engagement end date.
